title: Our English Class
text:
My name is Ana. I am in a class with thirty students. Twenty students are girls and ten students are boys. We study English every day.

Our teacher is Mr. Lima. He is fifty years old. He has sixty books at home. He likes to read with us every Friday.

questions.text: How many students are in Ana's class?
What can we infer about Ana's class?
options: It has more girls than boys
It has more boys than girls

questions.text: What can we infer about Mr. Lima?

each one of a group, with no exceptions

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Ana. Eu estou em uma turma com trinta alunos. Vinte alunos são meninas e dez alunos são meninos. Nós estudamos inglês todos os dias.
Nosso professor é o Sr. Lima. Ele tem cinquenta anos. Ele tem sessenta livros em casa. Ele gosta de ler com a gente toda sexta-feira.
